summary.en: Chinese input method from the WeChat team. Linaro's Works on WoA data lists it as native Arm64, validated on Qualcomm hardware.

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
